headline: ELP advises Transworld on forming JV with Bainbridge to operate UAE shipping pool
sum: Transworld Shipping Lines Limited is set to form a joint venture with Bainbridge Navigation DMCC to establish a company in the United Arab Emirates to operate a shipping pool focused on handysize vessels in the dry bulk market, wherein…
detail: Transworld Shipping Lines Limited is set to form a joint venture with Bainbridge Navigation DMCC to establish a company in the United Arab Emirates to operate a shipping pool focused on handysize vessels in the dry bulk market, wherein Transworld is to hold 60% and Bainbridge is to hold 40%. Economic Laws Practice advised Transworld on all aspects of the transaction, including the cross-border joint venture structure, and drafted, reviewed and negotiated the term sheet and joint venture agreement. The transaction team consisted of Sujjain Talwar (Co-Founding Partner) and Vinit Shah (Associate Partner). The JV is intended to bring together Transworld’s vessels and commercial capabilities…
